articles.description: With up to $53 million from ARPA-H, the researchers will use AI to generate safer herbicides that reduce dependence on imports and improve the security of the U.S. food supply.

articles.title: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
articles.description: CodeRabbit uses OpenAI models to govern and trust AI-generated code and Codex to ship 20 times more software with the same engineering team.

articles.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins
articles.description: By learning how matter moves, the WorldParticle system could assist with developing soft robots, medicines, and more.

articles.description: The new approach, known as FLEX, could lead to more intuitive, interactive household and assistive robots.

articles.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
articles.description: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.

articles.title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
articles.description: Australian universities are expanding access to ChatGPT and bringing AI into teaching and learning to prepare students for an AI-enabled workforce.

articles.title: Formally verifying agent-written full-stack web apps with PDD Kit
articles.description: AI agents can generate code at a scale that’s hard for humans to review line-by-line. PDD Kit helps ensure the code is doing what the developer intended by creating formal specifications and testing against them. It converts developer intent into a Verus specification, proves AI-generated code meets it for every input, and uses tests where proofs aren't practical. Developers review intent, not every line.
